general_rule: Prefer observation-month direct physical exposures within a redundant biological exposure family; broader or derived summaries survive only when they add a distinct pre-specified process representation with usable coverage. Trait coefficients, P values and v2 candidate survival cannot arbitrate the choice.

pr_month.redundancy_preference: preferred over BIO12, BIO18 and GSP when those are redundant representations of hydric exposure

vpd_month.redundancy_preference: preferred as the direct atmospheric-demand representation when PET or CMI does not add a distinct process

tasmax_month.redundancy_preference: if tas_month and tasmax_month are strongly redundant and one thermal stress representation is sufficient, prefer tasmax_month because H2/H3 concern stress exposure while H5 permits maximum-temperature context

sfcWind_month.use_boundary: pre-specified secondary orientation/architecture exposure, not a mandatory driver in every primary module model

pet_month.redundancy_preference: reject from the minimal primary representation when the direct VPD/precipitation pair captures the same information; retain only if environment-only diagnostics show a distinct process representation

cmi_month.redundancy_preference: reject from the minimal primary representation when redundant with precipitation/VPD/PET; retain only if it adds distinct moisture-availability information

BIO12.redundancy_preference: observation-month precipitation has priority when redundant

BIO18.redundancy_preference: observation-month precipitation has priority when redundant

GSP.redundancy_preference: observation-month precipitation has priority when redundant

BIO1.redundancy_preference: month-aligned thermal exposure has priority when redundant

BIO4.use_boundary: not promoted into the primary representation merely because it is non-redundant; there is no frozen primary seasonality hypothesis

BIO15.use_boundary: not promoted into the primary representation merely because it is non-redundant; there is no frozen primary seasonality hypothesis

NPP.use_boundary: not part of the minimal primary abiotic representation unless a separately labelled resource-context analysis is justified without trait outcomes

decision_rules: Coverage may veto a preferred direct exposure if it is not usable on the intended native-range cohort, but no trait outcome may arbitrate the fallback.

At the contract redundancy flag of absolute correlation >= 0.80, prefer the biologically closer direct exposure within the same process family unless the alternative represents a separately pre-specified process.
Non-redundancy alone is not sufficient to promote BIO4, BIO15 or NPP into a primary mechanistic model.

The final decision may assign retained variables different roles such as primary_direct, secondary_predefined or sensitivity_only; selected variables are not automatically entered into every trait-module model.
Every one of the 15 diagnosed candidates must appear exactly once as selected or rejected with a reason in the final environment decision.
claim_boundary: This priority file fixes environment-selection logic only. It contains no capitulum-trait result and does not authorize ecological fitting before the environment freeze receipt exists.
